verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS virtual mail service with web, API and MCP surfaces, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. Address privacy, encryption and access controls are adjacent security features and earn no credit for this story.
